row.evidence: Deepnote's pricing page lists 'SSO & directory sync' under Enterprise ('Custom Talk to us'), and its docs say 'Deepnote supports directory sync via SCIM' and 'This feature is available on the Enterprise plan.'
row.notes: Status unchanged (gated): SSO and SCIM directory sync are Enterprise-only and set up with Deepnote support. The Team price on the pricing page now reads '$39 -20% per editor/month billed yearly'; June recorded $31.20 annual / $39 monthly, which the current page does not show, so $39 billed yearly is used. No public SCIM endpoint, operations or attribute docs; IdP groups map to Viewer/Editor/Admin roles. The Okta OIN app is OIDC sign-in only. The public API (Team and Enterprise) covers notebooks, projects and runs, not user management; the audit log (Enterprise) is a CSV export.

plans.name: Team
plans.price_text: $39 per editor/month billed yearly (shown with a -20% badge)
plans.notes: The Notebook API is on Team but does not manage users.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Audit log is exportable as CSV from the UI; no audit-log API documented.

scim.notes: Set up with Deepnote support or the CSM; no public SCIM reference.

roles.how: Default IdP groups 'Deepnote Viewer', 'Deepnote Editors' and 'Deepnote Admins' map to Viewer, Editor and Admin; users in no group get Viewer; custom group-to-role mappings are set by Deepnote support.

limitations.text: Nested groups are not supported for role assignment; users must be direct members.
Directory sync is configured by Deepnote support, not self-serve.

user_api.notes: Deepnote's Public API v2 (Team and Enterprise, bearer API key from Settings & members > Security > API keys) covers blocks, files, integrations, machines, notebooks, projects, runs, sessions and Streamlit apps; its only identity endpoint is 'Me'. No member or user endpoints. Audit log is a CSV export in the UI.

okta.notes: OIN page marks only OIDC as checked (no SCIM, Create or Deactivate), read from the --checked classes in page markup.

searched: https://deepnote.com/sitemap.xml (docs URLs filtered for scim, sso, directory, api, audit, member, role)
open_questions: No public SCIM documentation: base URL, auth, endpoints, operations, deprovisioning behaviour and attributes are unknown.
Which IdPs Deepnote's SCIM directory sync supports is not stated.
The Team card reads '$39 -20% per editor/month billed yearly'; it is unclear whether $39 is the yearly-billed price or the pre-discount monthly price (June recorded $31.20 annual).
Whether SSO must be configured before directory sync is not stated.
Enterprise price and seat minimum are not public.
Entra gallery, Google, OneLogin and JumpCloud catalogue pages were not checked.
